envelope.derivation: runTapeEnvelopeForContract('e2-trestle'): finalWave=max(secureWave 12, baron.wave 12)+6=18; contractTicks=ceil((18*30/0.7)/(1/30))=23143; maxTicks=max(18000,23143)+2=23145; maxEntries=ceil(23145/5)=4629; maxOrderEntries=ceil(23145/30)=772; maxTapeBytes=16384+4629*160+772*2240=2486304. ALL THREE AXES PASS (ticks 80%, entries 8.5%, bytes 55.7%). The charter's 592544 figure is the conservative floor formula (16KiB + maxEntries*160); the live ceiling adds maxOrderEntries*(2400-160).
